intro: Ecuador is the world's biggest banana exporter and also sells oil, shrimp and flowers.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Bananas, shrimp, cocoa, roses and oil are top exports. In 2023 voters chose to stop oil drilling in part of Yasuní National Park.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Galápagos tourism is strictly limited to protect wildlife.

keyTerms.meaning: Using the US dollar as the national currency.

cardGroups.title: Made in Ecuador
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Ecuador makes and sells to the world.
